about: M0 test set. Read each 'text' aloud naturally, the way you would say it to a friend or an AI agent (don't read it word by word). 'english' lists words that must come out in English spelling. Audio files go to spec/fixtures/audio/<id>.wav (not committed). Silence items (text empty) check that an engine writes nothing when nobody speaks. Format items (category 'format', D-030): 'say' is what to speak, 'text' the expected formatted output (lines, lists, digits); 'format' says what the format score checks: list = dash / ordered / any / null (no list), items = list items, absent = words that must be gone (take-backs, fillers), digits = strings that must appear.
